--- CRM notes (shorthand) ---
Lead: BridgePath (mid-market sales enablement SaaS). Use-case: outbound SDR chat agents that can take actions in customer's CRM + send mail + schedule meetings. Primary ask: low-latency streaming responses + deterministic tool-calling latencies (token streaming p95 target ~120ms, end-to-end action latency <500ms).

Technical: prototype integrated with their Node.js microservice; plan to test Hosted API first to validate latency SLOs and tool-calling reliability. Ramping to ~200 concurrent agents in POC, average session ~45 turns, median utterance length 20 tokens. Interested in prefix caching + KV cache to reduce repeated context costs. Also wants function/tool schemas (strict typing) to map to internal CRM endpoints.

Security/compliance: must pass SOC2 review, SSO/SAML for admin console, audit logs for tool calls, KMS integration for key wrapping, data residency preference NA with option to keep EU data in EU. Legal asked for DPA + standard indemnity.

Commercial: initial ARR target if successful: $60k-120k/year. Considering Hosted API for speed -> Dedicated reserved pool for predictable p95 latency and cost control. AE walked through Dedicated pricing model; customer asks for committed QPS tiers and burst behavior.

POC success criteria (agreed):
- p95 token-stream latency <= 150ms in simulated 200-concurrent agent traffic
- Tool-call success rate >= 99.5% for CRM/email/calendar actions
- End-to-end median action completion < 400ms, p95 < 700ms
- Cost per MAU estimate and projection for Dedicated sizing
